code_comments: Read raw DWORD item count at descriptor +0x37; unaligned field; no wrapper count/range validation.
DWORD +0x3f must equal 1 for c6-byte reader; meaning of guard field unresolved.
Mode is full DWORD at entry ESP+0x8: zero=>ordinary fread-like 00945bfe; nonzero=>custom 00932c30. Both receive(dest,c6,count,stream).
Compare returned items with original raw32 count; SETE then zero-extension yields EAX 0/1. Failure does not roll back helper side effects.
